title: tc-geo-location
description:
Coordinates made useful – decimal or degrees-minutes-seconds, Copy, links to mapping tools and an embedded map that
loads only when asked.

latitude.description: The latitude, −90 to 90 – used when `points` is empty

longitude.description: The longitude, −180 to 180 – used when `points` is empty

label.description: What the place is, e.g. "North weather mast" – used when `points` is empty

zoom.description: The map zoom, 1 (the world) to 19 (a building)

points.description: Several places to switch between, instead of latitude / longitude

selected.description: The shown point's id when `points` is given; null shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

notation.description: Decimal (57.041200, −3.612700) or degrees-minutes-seconds. Changed by the user unless a tc-notation-change listener calls preventDefault()

precision.description: Decimal places shown in decimal notation

providers.description: The mapping tools, replacing the defaults – spread `defaultGeoProviders` to add to them. Only http(s) templates are kept

embedNote.description: Says where the map loads from under Show map, e.g. "The map loads from openstreetmap.org" – by default the embed's host

label.description: What the place is, e.g. "North weather mast"

zoom.description: The map zoom for this point, 1–19; by default the element's `zoom`

GeoProvider.description: A mapping tool. `url` is a template: {lat}, {lng}, {zoom} and {label} are replaced, encoded for a URL. Only http(s) links are kept.
